commit_message: Add first-release ADR visual validation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete first-release ADR visual validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds the deterministic first-release Editor Visual Validation suite for ADR0136, ADR0137, ADR0138, ADR0139, ADR0144, ADR0149, and ADR0153 on current main after ADR0157 landed.

The suite captures each ADR scenario in an independent Editor process, preserves per-scenario logs and partial-failure summaries, and keeps AI Studio fixtures compatible with the current runtime-debug implementation.

This revision also fixes the multi-capture AuthoringTool propagation failure, expands the ADR0136 residency evidence surface so required text is not clipped, and moves existing Animation Set tests after production items so full-workspace clippy can pass without lint suppression.

Supersedes Draft PR #774 and the older #673 implementation branch; do not merge both.
